$comment: Hand-maintained source: no emitter writes this file (export-copy.ts left with v0's copy leaves in #1020 wave 6). Its twin is mobile/shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/dev/centraid/design/copy/LockerCopy.kt; edit both, and KitTimeMoneyCopySpec fails when their strings disagree.

strings.ACCESS_NONE: Nothing on this item has been revealed yet.
strings.ACCESS_NOTE: Every reveal, copy and code writes a receipt · it names the field and the time, never the value.
strings.ACCESS_WINDOW: The latest {n} are drawn · older receipts are kept.
strings.ARCHIVED_EMPTY_BODY: Archive keeps an item forever and out of the lists.
strings.CODE_COPIED: Code copied · the clipboard clears itself when the code rolls
strings.CODE_NOTE: Next code in {seconds} s · the receipt is already written
strings.CODE_NOT_A_SEED: That seed does not make codes. Edit the item and paste the key again.
strings.COMPROMISED_CLEARS: Saving a new password clears this flag.
strings.COMPROMISED_NOTE: Review lists it for changing · a new password clears the flag.
strings.COMPROMISED_NOTE_NO_PASSWORD: Review lists it for changing until you clear the flag.
strings.COPIED_SECRET: {field} copied · the clipboard clears itself in 30 seconds
strings.DAY_ONE_BODY: Add a login, a card or a note · its secret is sealed the moment it is saved.
strings.DENIED_BODY: The vault refused Locker's read. Nothing was deleted.
strings.DISCARD_BODY: What you typed here is not saved, and a typed secret is cleared.
strings.EDITOR_LEDE: A secret is sealed on this phone when you save · until then it is only on this screen.
strings.EXPORT_COMMIT_NOTE: A sovereign vault must let you leave · Locker asks it is you, then the system asks where to save it.
strings.EXPORT_CONFIRM_BODY: Anything that reads the file reads your secrets. Locker asks it is you first, then the system asks where to save it.
strings.EXPORT_CONFIRM_TITLE: Write every secret to a file?
strings.EXPORT_FORMAT_CSV_NOTE: A 1Password-dialect CSV, so the file lands somewhere else without a converter.
strings.EXPORT_FORMAT_JSON_NOTE: Locker's own: every type, field, tag and memo, which Locker imports back whole.
strings.EXPORT_LEAVES_OUT: Not in the file: the trash, previous passwords and passkeys' keys.
strings.EXPORT_LEDE: This writes every title, username, address, note and password to a plaintext file on this device. Anything that reads the file reads your secrets. There is no encrypted export today.
strings.EXPORT_NOTHING: Nothing is kept here yet, so there is nothing to write.
strings.EXPORT_NOT_SAVED: Not saved · the export was receipted, and no file was written.
strings.EXPORT_NO_SAVER: This phone cannot save the file.
strings.EXPORT_PROMPT_REASON: Confirm it is you to write every secret in Locker to a file.
strings.EXPORT_PROMPT_SUBTITLE: Anything that reads the file reads your secrets.
strings.EXPORT_SAVE_REFUSED: The file could not be saved · no file was written.
strings.EXPORT_WHAT_MANY: {n} items · every field, in the clear
strings.EXPORT_WHAT_ONE: {n} item · every field, in the clear
strings.EXPORT_WHERE_NOTE: Locker keeps no copy and sends it nowhere · what happens to the file afterwards is outside the vault.
strings.EXPORT_WHERE_VALUE: Where you choose, in the system's save sheet
strings.EXPORT_WRITING: Opening every secret · the receipt is already written.
strings.EXPORT_WRITTEN: Written · every secret is in that file now.
strings.EXPORT_WRITTEN_PARTIAL: Written · {n} secrets did not open with this phone's key and are not in the file.
strings.FACT_KEY_DETAIL: Comes from your 24 words · never saved to a file, and your words bring it back
strings.FACT_LEAVING_DETAIL: Locks at once · revealed values are cleared, and a copied secret clears itself within 30 seconds
strings.FACT_REVEAL_DETAIL: One field, thirty seconds, and a receipt written first
strings.FACT_SESSION_DETAIL: Five minutes, sliding with use, in memory only
strings.FIELD_LABEL_MISSING: A label first — a field with none is a value nobody can find again.
strings.FIELD_REMOVE_BODY: Its value is erased from the vault. This cannot be undone.
strings.FIELD_SEALED_ON_SAVE: Sealed on this phone when you save · revealed like any other secret, with a receipt.
strings.FIELD_TEXT_NOTE: Plain text · shown on the item, never searched.
strings.GENERATED_COPIED: Copied · the clipboard clears itself in 30 seconds
strings.IMPORT_DONE_NOTE: The file you chose still holds every secret in the clear · delete it once you are done.
strings.IMPORT_FAILED: That file could not be read.
strings.IMPORT_FILE_NOTE: A password-manager CSV — Chrome, 1Password, Bitwarden, LastPass, Firefox — or a Locker export · read on this phone and sent nowhere.
strings.IMPORT_LEDE: Choose, review, add · nothing reaches the vault until you add it, and the vault wins every collision.
strings.IMPORT_NOTHING: Nothing in that file was recognised
strings.IMPORT_NOT_READABLE: That file is not a password-manager CSV or a Locker export · nothing was read into the vault.
strings.IMPORT_PUBLISH_NOTE: Each secret is sealed on this phone as it is added · held rows are left as they are.
strings.IMPORT_VERDICT_HELD: a vault secret already exists — the vault wins
strings.IMPORT_VERDICT_SKIPPED: not an item, or a repeat of an earlier row
strings.ITEMS_STATUS: Titles, usernames and addresses are browsable · a secret is revealed per item, per gesture, and receipted
strings.ITEM_GONE_BODY: It was erased, or never on this phone.
strings.ITEM_STATUS: Sealed at rest. A reveal writes a receipt and conceals itself after 30 seconds.
strings.KEEPS_BACKUP_DETAIL: The laptop keeps sealed items · it never has the key
strings.KEEPS_LIST_DETAIL: Titles, usernames, addresses and tags, readable at rest so the list and search work
strings.KEEPS_RECEIPTS_DETAIL: Every unlock and every reveal writes one, with the time
strings.KEEPS_SECRET_DETAIL: Sealed under a key from your 24 words · never searched, never in a log
strings.KEPT_SEALED: Kept sealed · type to replace it
strings.LOCK_BODY_LEAD: Titles and secrets stay covered until you unlock with
strings.LOCK_DID_NOT_OPEN: Locker did not open on this phone.
strings.LOCK_FAILED: Not recognised. Try again, or use the passcode.
strings.LOCK_FAILED_PASSCODE: That did not unlock Locker. Try again.
strings.LOCK_LOCKED_OUT: Too many tries. Unlock the phone with its passcode, then try again.
strings.LOCK_NO_WORDS_BODY: Locker's secrets open with a key from your 24 words, and this phone does not hold them for this vault.
strings.LOCK_NO_WORDS_NOTICE: Every item is still here. Its secrets stay sealed, not lost.
strings.LOCK_UNAVAILABLE_BODY: Locker opens with this phone's own lock, and this phone has none.
strings.LOCK_UNAVAILABLE_NOTICE: Set a passcode in Settings, then come back.
strings.LOOKALIKES: Look-alikes such as 0, O, 1 and l are never used.
strings.MEMO_HINT: Plain and searchable · not the place for a secret.
strings.MORE_EXPORT_META: Plaintext, with the warning it deserves
strings.MORE_FACTS_META: And what never leaves this phone
strings.NO_ANSWER: Centraid did not answer the lock.
strings.NO_VAULT: No vault is open on this phone.
strings.OTP_COUNTER_BASED: That link is for counter-based codes, which Locker does not make. Ask the site for a time-based code.
strings.OTP_HINT: Paste the setup key or the otpauth:// link the site showed
strings.OTP_NOTE: Sealed · a new code every 30 seconds · showing one writes a receipt
strings.OTP_NOT_A_SEED: That is not a one-time-code setup key. Paste the key or the otpauth:// link the site showed.
strings.OTP_UNSUPPORTED: That link asks for a code Locker does not make: only six digits every thirty seconds, with SHA-1.
strings.PASSKEY_NOTE: Sealed, and never shown or copied · Locker keeps a passkey but cannot make or use one on this phone
strings.PASSKEY_REMOVE_BODY: Its key is erased from the vault. The site still expects it until you remove it there too.
strings.PROMPT_REASON: Unlock Locker to see your items and reveal a secret.
strings.PROMPT_SUBTITLE: Your items stay covered until you do.
strings.PURGE_BODY: It is erased now, with its secrets, fields and history. This cannot be undone.
strings.READ_INCOMPLETE: Locker could not read this item.
strings.REVEALED_NOTE: Conceals itself in {seconds} s · the receipt is already written
strings.REVEAL_DID_NOT_OPEN: That secret did not open on this phone.
strings.REVEAL_GONE: That item is no longer here.
strings.REVEAL_LOCKED: Locker locked before it could reveal that.
strings.REVEAL_SEED: The setup key is never shown · Show code makes a code from it.
strings.REVIEW_BREACH_REASON: Checking would send data off this phone, and Locker sends none.
strings.REVIEW_CLEAR_BODY: No item is flagged, served over http, or past its expiry.
strings.REVIEW_COMPROMISED_REASON: Flagged by hand · change the password where it is used.
strings.REVIEW_EXPIRING_REASON: Expires this month or within the next two.
strings.REVIEW_HTTP_REASON: An http address sends what you type in the clear.
strings.REVIEW_NOTE_TRUNCATED: Checked the first {items} today · the review reads 2,000 at most
strings.REVIEW_WEAK_REASON: Checking them would mean unsealing every password at once, which this phone does not do.
strings.SEALED_NOTE: Sealed at rest · revealing writes a receipt
strings.SEARCH_NOTE: Secret values and notes are not searched. A note routinely holds recovery codes, so it is excluded by design.
strings.TRASH_EMPTY_BODY: A trashed item keeps its star and tags for thirty days, so a restore brings it back whole.
strings.WINDOW: {shown} of {total} · the window is 300 by default and 2,000 at most.
strings.WINDOW_UNKNOWN: More than this window holds · the window is 300 by default and 2,000 at most.
